content:
Overview

Mackay is a city in Queensland with a population of 86,002. Queensland’s sugar capital with beautiful beaches, the Eungella National Park, and a thriving mining industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
